title: Pan-Seared Duck Breast with Thai Stir Fry Sauce
description: A French-inspired dish with a flavorful twist, combining the richness of duck breast with the spicy kick of Thai stir fry sauce.
instructions: Season the duck breast with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck breast for 2-3 minutes on each side, then transfer to the preheated oven.
Cook for 12-15 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a separate skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onions, and cook until tender.
Stir in the grated ginger, minced garlic, soy sauce, and fish sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened.
Serve the pan-seared duck breast with the Thai stir fry sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
